verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks Esplanadi Park in the heart of Helsinki.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking Esplanadi Park in the heart of the city, Hotel Kämp has been Helsinki's grand hotel and meeting place since 1887.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the middle of Helsinki's shopping district, with designer shops, museums, the harbor and the main sights within walking distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is located in Helsinki center, across from Esplanadi Park and in the middle of the city's shopping district. Designer shops, museums, the harbor, and the city's main sights are all within walking distance.

verified_facts.text: Hotel Kamp opened in 1887 as Finland's first European-style grand hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opened in 1887 as Finland's first European-style grand hotel, it introduced the city to elevators, moving pictures, and a taste for eating out

verified_facts.text: The building was Finland's first with a passenger elevator.
verified_facts.excerpt: The building he built was Finland's first with a passenger elevator, wired throughout with electric light

verified_facts.text: The architect was Theodor Hoijer, whose other buildings include the Ateneum Art Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: The architecture was the work of Theodor Höijer, whose other buildings include the Ateneum Art Museum a few streets away.

verified_facts.text: Jean Sibelius, Akseli Gallen-Kallela and other artists were regulars, forming a circle they named the Symposium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jean Sibelius, Akseli Gallén-Kallela, Juhani Aho, Oskar Merikanto, Pekka Halonen, and Eero Järnefelt were regulars, gathering so often that they named their own circle: the Symposium.

verified_facts.text: C.G.E. Mannerheim, Finland's wartime commander-in-chief and sixth president, stayed at the hotel for the entire summer of 1919.
verified_facts.excerpt: C.G.E. Mannerheim stayed at Hotel Kämp for the entire summer of 1919

verified_facts.text: The hotel closed in 1965, when a bank took over the site, and was restored and reopened in 1999.
verified_facts.excerpt: The bank's headquarters opened on the site in 1969 and remained until 1997 — until 1999, when, to the delight of Helsinki, Hotel Kämp was restored and reopened.

verified_facts.text: The hotel went through a comprehensive refurbishment in 2024-2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Kämp, went through a comprehensive refurbishment in 2024-2026.

verified_facts.text: The hotel remained open throughout the refurbishment, with full renovation completing in October 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel remained open throughout the whole refurbishment, full renovation completing in October 2026.

verified_facts.text: In July 2026 the hotel introduced Kamp Spa, a new wellness retreat with water elements.
verified_facts.excerpt: in July 2026, Hotel Kämp introduced a new wellness retreat, Kämp Spa, with water elements as part of its expanded amenities.

verified_facts.text: Kamp Spa has traditional Finnish, steam and infrared saunas, a vitality pool and a cold plunge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Traditional Finnish, steam, and infrared saunas complete the contrast therapy alongside a vitality pool and cold plunge, with the Spa Lounge on hand for food and drink after.

verified_facts.text: Kamp Spa combines Finnish traditions with modern wellness, including heat and cold therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kämp Spa combines Finnish traditions with modern wellness: heat and cold therapies, results-driven treatments, and technology designed to support real recovery.

verified_facts.text: The Sibelius Suite has a grand piano, a kitchen, private sauna facilities and views over Esplanadi Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Sibelius Suite has room to host gatherings — and a grand piano to set the mood. The suite also has a kitchen, private sauna facilities and views overlooking Esplanadi Park.

verified_facts.text: The Mannerheim Suite has a private balcony, kitchenette and a separate private entrance.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suite has a private balcony, kitchenette and a separate private entrance, to ensure discreet service.

verified_facts.text: Some Executive Park View rooms feature an original tiled stove.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some rooms feature an original tiled stove as a nod to the building's history.

verified_facts.text: All suites include breakfast served in the suite and access to Kamp Spa and the Upper Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: All suites include breakfast served in the suite, access to Kämp Spa and Upper Lounge, and other exclusive services.

verified_facts.text: Restaurant A La Kamp reworks the hotel's own archival menus through French technique and a Finnish eye for ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Restaurant À La Kämp** reworks the hotel's own archival menus through French technique and a Finnish eye for ingredients, seasonal and often local.

verified_facts.text: The A La Kamp menu includes traditional salmon soup, Toast Skagen, Chateaubriand and grilled lobster.
verified_facts.excerpt: From traditional salmon soup and Toast Skagen to Chateaubriand, grilled lobster and seasonal specialities, every plate reflects a commitment to exceptional ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Kamp Bar is known for hand-crafted cocktails and a deep affection for champagne.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Kämp Bar** is known for hand-crafted cocktails and a deep affection for champagne.

verified_facts.text: Kamp Delicatessen is a neighborhood deli by day and an intimate wine bar by night.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Kämp Delicatessen** is a neighborhood deli by day, and turns into an intimate wine bar by night.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers 24-hour room service, concierge, turndown service and complimentary Wi-Fi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 24-hour room service and concierge are here for whatever your stay needs. Turndown service is included in your room and laundry service is also available. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is available for guests arriving by car.
verified_facts.excerpt: For guests arriving by car, our valet will take care of parking, while our bellboys bring your luggage to your room.

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes up to two pets per room, and well-behaved dogs are welcome at A La Kamp and Kamp Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Kämp welcomes up to two pets per room, with a welcome gift waiting on arrival. Well-behaved dogs are also welcome at À La Kämp and Kämp Bar.

verified_facts.text: All room categories can accommodate a third guest with an extra bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our room categories can accommodate a third guest with an extra bed, and select rooms can host larger groups.

verified_facts.text: The Mirror Room is a ballroom in the hotel used for events.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel also has ten event spaces for meetings and celebrations, including the Mirror Room, the most storied ballroom in Helsinki.

verified_facts.text: Smoking is not permitted inside the hotel building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Smoking is not permitted inside the hotel building. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas.
